name: A4
mesh_airframe: McDonnell Douglas A-4E/F/G/H/K Skyhawk (the owner's own FSX / P3D model, 2020; converted locally, never committed)

license.author: Dhruva Valluru (the project owner)
license.permission: the owner, as the model's author and copyright holder, authorised converting the model, using rendered images of it in the public dataset, and using it in this project (2026-09-29); the downloaded package ships no licence text of its own
license.not_redistributed: the model, its textures and the paint kit are never committed to this public repository (assets/aircraft_src/ and assets/generated/ are gitignored)
license.trademarks: the paint kit's liveries carry real insignia (US Navy, Blue Angels, Top Gun, Israeli and Australian roundels); the Blue Angels name and emblem are US Navy trademarks -- research renders only, check before any commercial use
license.unavailable: the licence is settled, but the geometry is not yet here: the package ships only as FSX / P3D Windows installers (no loose .mdl, no editable source), so nothing can be converted until the model is exported to OBJ / FBX (from the author's original source, or the installed .mdl via ModelConverterX on Windows) and placed with NOTICE.txt (the attribution line as its first line) in assets/aircraft_src/A4/. Physics-only until then.

dimensions_m.source: [unverified here] published A-4F overall length 40 ft 3 in (12.27 m) and height 15 ft (4.57 m), from memory of the type's standard characteristics; span is taken from the flown FDM's own <wingspan>

nose.source: the FDM's structural origin taken as the nose tip (Aeromatic v0.9, which generated A4.xml, references its stations from the nose); z at the CG waterline

tail.source: nose tip + the type's overall length 12.27 m [unverified here] at the CG waterline

n_z_pos_g.reason: not transcribed: no A-4 NATOPS flight manual limitations page is on hand here

alpha_stall_deg.reason: the JSBSim A4 model (Aeromatic v0.9) states no alpha limit

limits.note: A4.xml is an Aeromatic v0.9 model 'created using publicly available data, publicly available technical reports, textbooks, and guesses' (its own file header): unvalidated, so every limit monitored against it would be graded on a guessed airframe.
